key_decisions.decision: Keeps inner disturbance, both expert groups, plural dreams, and their failure.
Preserves Joseph’s youth, ethnicity, enslaved status, and individualized interpretations.
Keeps prison-as-pit continuity and all preparations without assuming whether he shaved hair or beard.
Preserves Joseph’s self-denial and the consequential, somewhat ambiguous shalom wording rather than reducing it to favorable.
Preserves the dream’s unnatural detail and Pharaoh’s awakening.
Preserves divine certainty and urgency without implying two unrelated dreams.
Chooses the contextual taxation sense of the rare verb and preserves the precise fraction.
Leaves spirit of God’s capitalization interpretively open in Pharaoh’s polytheistic setting.
Uses obey as the contextual sense of the uncertain mouth-related expression while retaining Pharaoh’s sole superiority.
Uses a cautious functional rendering of the uncertain Egyptian/Hebrew acclamation and notes the ambiguity.
Preserves the Egyptian names, marriage arranged by Pharaoh, priesthood, and Joseph’s new reach without guessing name meanings.
Retains the unusual handfuls expression while supplying its agricultural object from context.
Retains the name association and Joseph’s difficult claim without implying literal amnesia.
Preserves the name association and holds fruitfulness together with affliction.
Retains the ancient face image and the sale—not free distribution—while supplying storehouses from context.
